jobs.title: IBPS PO / MT-XV Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026 Online Form
jobs.intro: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the Common Recruitment Process (CRP PO/MT-XV) for Probationary Officers and Management Trainees in 11 participating public sector banks across India. Eligible graduates can submit online applications.
jobs.dates:
• Online Registration Starts : 01 August 2026
• Last Date to Apply & Pay Fee : 28 August 2026
• Online Prelims Exam Date : October 2026
• Online Mains Exam Date : November 2026
• Interview Call Letters : January / February 2027
jobs.fee:
• General / OBC / EWS : ₹ 850/-
• SC / ST / PwBD Candidates : ₹ 175/-
• Payment Mode : Online Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, UPI, IMPS
jobs.age:
• Minimum Age : 20 Years
• Maximum Age : 30 Years (Age relaxation: OBC 3 yrs, SC/ST 5 yrs, PwD 10 yrs)
jobs.qualification:
• Educational Qualification: A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized University by the Govt. of India or any equivalent qualification.
• Candidate must possess valid Marksheet/Degree Certificate at the time of online registration.
• Computer Literacy: Operating and working knowledge in computer systems is desirable.
jobs.vacancies_detail: • Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, Punjab National Bank, Union Bank of India, Indian Bank, Bank of India, Central Bank of India, UCO Bank, Punjab & Sind Bank, Bank of Maharashtra, Indian Overseas Bank.

admission.title: NTA CUET UG 2026 Central University Entrance Test Online Registration
admission.total_posts: All Central Universities (DU, BHU, JNU, JMI, AU)
admission.intro: National Testing Agency (NTA) conducts the Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG) for admission into undergraduate programs across all Central Universities and participating State/Deemed/Private Universities in India.
admission.dates:
• Online Registration : February – March 2026
• Correction Window : April 2026
• Exam Dates : May 2026
• Result Declaration : June / July 2026
admission.fee:
• Up to 3 Subjects : Gen ₹ 1,000/- | OBC/EWS ₹ 900/- | SC/ST/PwBD ₹ 800/-
• Additional subjects charged per paper.
admission.age: • No age limit for appearing in CUET UG. (Candidates must satisfy university-specific criteria).
admission.qualification: • Passed Class 12th / Intermediate examination or appearing in the qualifying examination from any recognized board in India.
admission.vacancies_detail: • BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, B.Voc, Integrated Law (BA LLB), and Professional Undergraduate degree courses across 250+ Universities.
